categories.description: War, sanctions, armed conflict, political instability, trade restrictions, or cross-border disruption.
Inflation, interest rates, recession, unemployment, currency moves, or central-bank policy.
Default, missed payment, bankruptcy, credit downgrade, restructuring, or widening credit risk.
A merger, acquisition, takeover, divestiture, or material corporate combination.
A new product, service, platform, approval, or commercial launch.
Regulatory action, investigation, fine, penalty, compliance breach, or legal restriction.
Operational outage, cyber incident, accident, recall, supply disruption, or facility closure.
Financially relevant information that does not fit another defined event category.
